items.title: Demas
items.charge: Forsaking Paul, having loved this present world

items.title: Gehazi
items.charge: Greed and lying to a prophet

items.title: Jehoiakim
items.charge: Building with unrighteousness; shedding innocent blood; burning the scroll of the Lord's words

items.title: Jezebel and Naboth's vineyard
items.charge: Judicial murder to seize an inheritance

items.title: Judas Iscariot
items.charge: Theft from the common purse; betraying innocent blood for thirty pieces of silver

items.title: Ptolemy the son of Abubus
items.charge: Murdering Simon the high priest and two of his sons at a banquet in his own castle

items.title: Simon Magus
items.charge: Offering money for the gift of the Holy Ghost

items.charge: Betraying the temple treasury to the king out of a private quarrel; slandering Onias the high priest

items.title: The traders in the temple
items.charge: Making the house of prayer a den of thieves
